title.zh: 实际指令接续候选证据

detail.zh: 解释关联：复用完成的 G0/J 方向；实现条件不独自证明权限及目的正当。
detail.en: Interpretive connection: reuses the completed G0/J direction; implementation conditions do not independently justify permissions or ends.

claim.zh: 有界覆盖写入程序推导其实际变化范围，并以同一语义推进实际与候选；合法读取和已提交程序组成的任意有限历史维持实际覆盖，进而接入当前认证。
claim.en: A bounded overwrite program derives its executed change scope and transports actual and candidate states through the same semantics; arbitrary finite histories of lawful reads and committed programs preserve actual coverage and feed current certification.

hypotheses.zh: 初始实际覆盖、所列控制／失陷配置及读取对应；提交前检查当前权限、代次及资源；原提交是原子操作。
hypotheses.en: Initial actual coverage, represented control/fault configurations and read correspondence; current permissions, generation and resources are checked before an atomic original commit.

correspondence.zh: 实际写入与记录同属一段改变历史；物理语义及控制入口完整性仍需对应。
correspondence.en: Executed writes and records belong to the same changing history; physical semantics and complete mediation remain correspondence conditions.

detail.zh: 额外写入通道可保持全部公共记录不变而排除实际候选，使旧认证失实。
detail.en: An extra writer can leave every public record unchanged while excluding the actual candidate and making the old certificate misleading.

limitations.zh: 没有受保护运行时、物理故障恢复或伦理正当性证明；22项恢复扩展另列，不重算原27项。
limitations.en: No protected runtime, physical fault recovery or ethical legitimacy proof; the 22-theorem recovery extension is separate and does not recount the original 27.

validation_scope.zh: 迁移并核读既有27项定理／57项审计、24,416项记录匹配的原回执；此次恢复构建重新编译其源码但不新增该成果。
validation_scope.en: Migrates and reads the original receipt for 27 theorems / 57 audits and 24,416 matches; the recovery build recompiles this source without creating another result.

next_delta.zh: 直接复用此输出；受中断逐步实现由 recoverable-mediated-change 接通，真实持久保护及无旁路另需证明。
next_delta.en: Reuse this output; interrupted staged realization is supplied by recoverable-mediated-change, while physical durable protection and exclusion of bypasses need further evidence.

history.zh: 2026-10-09：从已有研究迁移同一主张；原证明、回执和反例保持，不计新理论成果。
history.en: 2026-10-09: migrated the same claim from the existing study; original proofs, receipt and counterexample remain, without a new scientific result.

history.zh: 2026-10-09：核读同研究§10、理论§14及“finish remains”来源的作者增量；更新三处文献指纹，原证明及实查回执未改，新增停止结果分列。
history.en: 2026-10-09: read the authored continuation in study §10, theory §14 and the “finish remains” provenance; reconciled three documentary fingerprints, leaving original proofs and scientific receipts unchanged; the stronger stopping result is separate.
